origin: ts.mbt — keyed-container receivers for class-method DCE
what: A computed-key read off a PRIVATE `Record` field is an entry lookup, and a private name is lexically the class's own, so the read clears the method-DCE gate. The same read off a PUBLIC field does not: `this.table[k]` in an object literal whose `table` holds a `Worker` really does name a `Worker` method, and clearing it deleted `spare` — the differential run sees `viaDynamic` turn from "S" into "GONE".
